subject: Private MAP Kickoff — stakeholder liaison, network/VPN, IAM/KMS owners & eval timeline (Acme Cloud)
messages:
From: Evelyn Hart <evelyn.hart@redwood.inference.com>
To: Jared Liu <jared.liu@acme.com>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.inference.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.inference.com>
Date: Mon, 21 Jun 2027 16:02:00 -0400
Subject: Private MAP Kickoff — stakeholder liaison, network/VPN, IAM/KMS owners & eval timeline (Acme Cloud)

Hi Jared / Acme team,

Thanks again for the time yesterday. Per our conversation I put together a first-pass mutual action plan (attached) to align owners and the short evaluation timeline for a Private/VPC deployment. Goal is to have an initial tech validation and security review complete so commercial terms can move to final signature in mid-July.

Key asks to get this moving:
- Please confirm your internal owners for: Networking/VPN, IAM/KMS, and Platform/Infra (names + best contact email).
- Review the attached MAP (ACME_Private_MAP_v1.xlsx) and the network checklist (network-checklist.pdf).
- Let us know if you prefer an initial 30-min tech sync (network + VPN) or a 60-min runbook review — Ben (SE) will drive the tech session.

Proposed owner assignments (Redwood side):
- Redwood Networking & VPN liaison: Ben Carter (ben.carter@redwood.inference.com)
- Redwood IAM / KMS liaison: Marissa Cole (marissa.cole@redwood.inference.com)
- Redwood engagement lead: Evelyn Hart (evelyn.hart@redwood.inference.com)

Tentative timeline (high level):
- Week 1 (this week): owner confirmations + tech sync
- Week 2: network validation, KMS integration checklist, SOC2 snapshot review
- Week 3: eval results, follow-up prompts / QA, finalize scope
- Target signature: by 2027-07-15

Attachments: ACME_Private_MAP_v1.xlsx, network-checklist.pdf, redwood-soc2-summary.pdf

If that looks good, Ben will propose a few slots for the tech sync. Thanks — looking forward to getting this moving.

Best,
Evelyn Hart
Senior Account Executive | Redwood Inference
E: evelyn.hart@redwood.inference.com | M: +1 (415) 555-0123

Evelyn — thanks, appreciate the clear plan. Quick responses below and a couple of requests from our side.

Owners from Acme:
- Networking / VPN: Sara Wang (sara.wang@acme.com) — will own VPC peering / transit setup
- IAM / KMS: opsteam@acme.com (team alias) — primary contact is Rajiv Patel (rajiv.patel@acme.com)
- Platform lead: jared.liu@acme.com (me)

We can do a 30-min tech sync to start focused on network/VPN and route tables; if that goes well we’ll schedule the deeper KMS handoff. Our security team asked for the SOC2 summary and an estimated retention plan for audit logs — I see you attached redwood-soc2-summary.pdf, could you also confirm expected retention window and whether audit logs can be exported to our S3?

I can take Wed 23 Jun at 10:00 PT or Thu 24 Jun at 09:00 PT for the sync. Either works for us.

Thanks Jared — Ben here (SE at Redwood). I’ll lead the network/VPN checklist and the initial validation. A couple of notes to make the sync productive:

Pre-reqs (please have these available):
- VPC IDs, CIDR ranges, and the route table that will be used for the peering/transit
- Bastion / jump host plan (if any) and allowed egress rules
- KMS owner contact (for key policy discussions) — Rajiv ok for us to loop in during the 2nd session

Proposed agenda for a 30-min sync (tech-only):
1) Quick intros + confirm owners (5m)
2) Network topology review & required firewall rules (10m)
3) KV/Key access pattern + KMS integration touchpoints (10m)
4) Action items & next steps (5m)

I’ll send a calendar invite for Wed 23 Jun 13:00 ET / 10:00 PT (30 minutes) — meeting link and runbook will be attached. If that slot is problematic, reply with two alternatives.

Appreciate the quick replies, team. Confirming the calendar invite — Ben will run the tech sync today at 13:00 ET. A couple of operational items from Redwood:

- We will publish MAP v2 after the tech sync with the updated owner roster and an explicit checklist for KMS key policies. Expect that by EOD Fri 24 Jun.
- Target commercial close we discussed internally is 2027-07-15; please flag any blockers to that cadence during or after the sync.
- On SOC2 / audit logs: we can export token-level audit logs to your S3 for the eval window; retention default is 90 days but we can extend to 365 on request (will note in MAP v2).

Next steps:
- Ben to run tech sync and capture action items
- Redwood to send MAP v2 + updated SOC2 retention note
- Acme to confirm Rajiv or KMS engineer for the follow-up session

Thanks — Marissa will take point for the KMS policy checklist and I’ll track the MAP milestones.

Best,
Marissa Cole
Sales Engineering Manager | Redwood Inference
